(John Black) ---------------------------------------------------------------------- >From dlnirllc@waikato.ac.nz  Sun Feb 24 10:30:37 2008 Message: 1 Date: Thu, 14 Feb 2008 15:44:57 +1300 From: Peter Reutemann  Subject: Re: [Wekalist] RE: Wekalist Digest, Vol 60, Issue 19 To: "Weka machine learning workbench list." 	 Message-ID: <47B3AB29.3040903@waikato.ac.nz> Content-Type: text/plain; charset=ISO-8859-1; format=flowed Please use a subject describing your post! > I am a new user of WEKA, now working to develop prediction model for > continuous time serious data. I am trying to work with regression > analysis. I am a bit problem with using filter to remove unwanted or > spike data. I want to know the filter details inbuilt with WEKA. Can > anyone have documents about filter, please let me know.  If you want to implement a filter, see FAQ "How do I write a new  classifier or filter?". Link to FAQs on the Weka homepage. > I am > interested about StratifiedRemoveFolds, Wavelet etc. filter.  See the corresponding Javadoc for more details or have a look at the code. > Is their > any way in WEKA to convert time series data into frequency domain? There's not much time-series support in Weka, only 2 filters (both in  package weka.filters.unsupervised.attribute):    TimeSeriesTranslate    TimeSeriesDelta HTH Cheers, Peter --  Peter Reutemann, Dept. of Computer Science, University of Waikato, NZ http://www.cs.waikato.ac.nz/~fracpete/     +64 (7) 838-4466 Ext. 5174 ------------------------------
